INSERT INTO escalation_experts (user_id, org_id, domains, tags, available)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
                org_id = EXCLUDED.org_id,
                domains = EXCLUDED.domains,
                tags = EXCLUDED.tags,
                available = EXCLUDED.available,
                updated_at = now()
